description: Plans and builds a medium-sized change in one file, `docs/changes/<slug>.md`: a fix or small enhancement too big for `quick-fix` but with no real design to do. Writes the problem, cause, approach and a short task list, gets one yes, then builds each task with the builder and reviewer agents and opens the PR. Use for a fix across several files, a fix that needs a few tests, or a small addition to existing behavior. Hands over to `feature-explore` when the change needs a design.
